verdict.rationale: Cline offers Plan mode for exploring code without changes and subagents that independently explore the codebase and report back, and one community reviewer praised its ability to work through a codebase 'almost always completely on the money.' However another hands-on comment explicitly says Cline is 'wrong' about its stance on codebase indexing and is 'missing a major feature' for whole-codebase understanding, directly contradicting the claim of comprehensive codebase comprehension. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a dedicated codebase-indexing/mapping feature, and resolution of the indexing complaint.
